text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black sailed through the St. Lite 
Kinen. Her concerns about the distance 
turned out to be completely unfounded.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond appears and shares the news 
that she might be able to debut soon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her next race is the Kikuka Sho. However, 
it comes to light that her greatest rival, 
Brusquemaent, will sit it out to undergo 
minor surgery.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black had lost her big goal. 
However, the real test was already right 
before her eyes.
